newsitem.title: INDIA: India Exim Bank raises $50 mln at LIBOR + 57.5 bp.
newsitem.headline: India Exim Bank raises $50 mln at LIBOR + 57.5 bp.

text.p: The Export-Import Bank of India (Exim Bank) said on Thursday it had raised a $50 million loan in international markets.
The loan was arranged by Singapore branch of The Fuji Bank Ltd, and the Hong Kong branch of Tokyo-Mitsubushi International, Exim Bank said in a statement.
The loan is for seven years with a put option after five years and is at a rate of 57.5 basis points over LIBOR, it said.
Exim Bank said it received subscriptions for $135 million and will retain only $50 million.

Exim Bank aims to enhance export competitiveness of Indian companies by financing their expansion, technology upgradation and modernisation, it said. It also assists Indian companies in programmes aimed at globalisation and technology transfers.
